2607.02079.title: HaloGuard 1.0: An Open Weights Constitutional Classifier for Multilingual AI Safety
2607.02079.paper_summary: We present HaloGuard 1.0, an open-weights implementation of the constitutional-classifier paradigm for input safety. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on English and multilingual prompt-safety benchmarks at roughly one-tenth the model size of current leading open guard models. The safety constitution is the organising structure of the corpus: a natural-language constitution of 46 policies and 2,940 subcategories drives synthetic data generation, with exhaustive one-to-one paired counterfactuals that hold topic and vocabulary fixed while flipping intent, a two-tier harmless design that separately targets boundary and baseline false positives (FPs), and balanced multilingual materialisation across 46 languages that treats language as a surface form appearing on both sides of the boundary rather than as an adversarial signal. Across seven prompt-safety benchmarks, HaloGuard 1.0-0.8B attains the best average F1 (90.9) of any open guard we evaluate, outperforming baselines up to 27B parameters (over 30 times larger) while holding false-positive rate (FPR) to 4.3 and false-negative rate (FNR) to 9.5. The HaloGuard 1.0-4B variant reaches average F1 of 92.1 and FPR of 3.5, spending its extra capacity on precision rather than recall. A structured adjudication of the remaining failures indicates that most apparent missed-harm cases are benchmark mislabels rather than genuine model misses. An always-on adversarial red-teaming protocol continuously hardens the guard against both content-level and agentic attacks. We release the models as open weights.
2607.02079.paper_summary_zh: 我們推出 HaloGuard 1.0，這是一個開放權重的憲法分類器範式實現，用於輸入安全。它在英語和多語言提示安全基準上達到了最先進的性能，模型大小約為當前領先開放防護模型的十分之一。安全憲法是語料庫的組織結構：一個包含 46 項政策和 2,940 個子類別的自然語言憲法驅動合成數據生成，並提供全面的一對一配對反事實，保持主題和詞彙不變，同時翻轉意圖，這是一種兩級無害設計，分別針對邊界和基線假陽性 (FP) ，以及在 46 種語言中平衡的多語言實現，將語言視為出現在邊界兩側的表面形式，而不是對抗性信號。在七個提示安全基準中，HaloGuard 1.0-0.8B 獲得了我們評估的任何開放防護中最佳的平均 F1 (90.9)，超越了高達 27B 參數的基線（超過 30 倍大），同時將假陽性率 (FPR) 控制在 4.3，假陰性率 (FNR) 控制在 9.5。HaloGuard 1.0-4B 變體的平均 F1 達到 92.1，FPR 為 3.5，將其額外容量用於精度而非召回。對剩餘失敗的結構化裁決表明，大多數明顯的漏害案例是基準錯誤標記，而非真正的模型漏失。一個始終啟用的對抗性紅隊協議不斷加強防護，抵禦內容層級和自主攻擊。我們將這些模型作為開放權重發布。
